items.title: Virtua Tennis 4 (ps Vita)
items.description: This item is FREE delivery. The world's top tennis stars are coming as a launch title for PlayStation Vita in Virtua Tennis 4, featuring Nadal, Federer, Djokovic, Murray, Sharapova, Williams and Wozniacki; plus legend players. Tennis on the go has never been better! Suitable for the PS Vita. Virtua Tennis 4 on the PS Vita offers everything gamers expect from a HD console game, plus some exciting new features using the unique PS Vita capabilities with touch panel, gyroscope, camera and 3G/Wi-Fi features. 22...
